platform_boundary: The indexed mono functions contain no display-map or OS-display call. 005e25e0 is never written by indexed direct refs and remains the file-backed 0x000b0000 value; the write/clear paths dereference that value as memory. Level starts at 2, so the >=2 gates alone do not disable writes. 0056a810 registers the optional XY callback only at level >2, but that does not establish memory usability or suppress other mono callers. No current original evidence proves a Win32 mapping or a safe host address for 0x000b0000. Indexed absence does not exclude indirect alias writes; those require separate relocation/consumer proof.
recommendation: Treat the seven mono bodies and seven cells as one candidate original-image subsystem for native proof, with a single canonical storage owner only after overlapping byte layout and alias checks. First supplement the SHA-guarded 00592ac0 function index and verify display-memory access or original disable conditions against the original process; then test 00592a50/005a299e/00592b60/00592d00/00592d70/00592e00 in one bounded harness using original state transitions and output bytes. Keep 0x000b0000 display effects external to the game build until their platform provenance is established; do not add a host screen replacement or guess a disabled level.
